# GUI Interface Description

## System Header Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" button
- **Center**: "Files" title
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 23:51"
  - System notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Background
- Gradient background transitioning from dark purple to red-orange
- Abstract geometric pattern with angular shapes

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - Google Chrome icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - Files application icon (highlighted with "Files" tooltip)
  - Ubuntu Software icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Trash icon
  - Grid icon for application overview

## File Explorer Windows

### Left Window: Trash View
- **Title Bar**: "Trash"
- **Navigation Controls**:
  - Back arrow
  - Forward arrow
  - Trash icon
  - More options (three dots)
  - Search icon
  - View options (list view, grid view)
  - Window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close)
- **Left Sidebar**:
  - "Recent" (with clock icon)
  - "Starred" (with star icon)
  - "Home" (with house icon)
  - "Desktop" (with folder icon)
  - "Documents" (with document icon)
  - "Downloads" (with download icon)
  - "Music" (with music note icon)
  - "Pictures" (with image icon)
  - "Videos" (with video camera icon)
  - "Trash" (with trash can icon, highlighted)
  - "Other Locations" (with plus icon)
- **Main Content Area**:
  - Large trash can icon
  - Text: "Trash is Empty"

### Right Window: Home Directory View
- **Title Bar**: "Home"
- **Navigation Controls**:
  - Back arrow
  - Forward arrow
  - Home icon
  - More options (three dots)
  - Search icon
  - View options (list view, grid view)
  - Window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close)
- **Left Sidebar**:
  - "Recent" (with clock icon)
  - "Starred" (with star icon)
  - "Home" (with house icon, highlighted)
  - "Desktop" (with folder icon)
  - "Documents" (with document icon)
  - "Downloads" (with download icon)
  - "Music" (with music note icon)
  - "Pictures" (with image icon)
  - "Videos" (with video camera icon)
  - "Trash" (with trash can icon)
  - "Other Locations" (with plus icon)
- **Main Content Area**:
  - Grid of files and folders:
    - Desktop
    - Documents
    - Downloads
    - Music
    - Pictures
    - Public
    - requirement.txt
    - server
    - snap
    - Templates
    - Videos
    - .cache
    - .config
    - .gnupg
    - .ipython
    - .lessht
    - .local
    - .mozilla
    - .pki
    - .profile
    - .selected_editor
    - .ssh
    - .sudo_as_admin_successful
    - thunderbird
    - .var
    - .viminfo
    - .vscode

## Desktop Icons
- **Bottom Right Corner**:
  - PowerPoint file icon labeled "CPD_Background_Inv..."
  - Home folder icon labeled "Home"
